name: Phong Nha
provinceNote: The park’s own pages give the address as Phong Nha Commune, Quang Tri Province.
summary: Sleep in Phong Nha village if the boat cave is why you came. From the Tourism Center the visit is about two and a half hours: a boat down the Son River and into the mouth. The entrance is 150,000 VND and the boat is extra. Paradise Cave is a separate ticket at Km 16, and it is not part of this half-day. The drive back to Hue is check on arrival.
timeNeeded: Half a day for the boat cave
fee: Each cave has its own ticket
getThere: Dong Hoi Airport (VDH), then the road. The park puts the cave about 50 km from Dong Hoi. The minutes are check on arrival.
seoTitle: Phong Nha travel guide — the boat cave, half a day
seoDescription: The Phong Nha Cave visit is about two and a half hours by boat. The 150,000 VND entrance does not include the boat, and Paradise Cave is a separate ticket.
intro: You start at the Tourism Center on the Son River. The boat runs downstream for about 30 minutes, the engine goes off, and the crew rows you about 1,200 metres into Phong Nha Cave. The park puts that visit at about two and a half hours. Sleep in the village if you want that morning without a transfer.

Stay if the boat is the trip. Head for Hue if you wanted the citadel instead. The park puts the cave about 50 km from Dong Hoi and does not print the minutes, so do not treat the airport as a quick stop before a flight. Paradise Cave is the dry walk, at Km 16 on the west Ho Chi Minh road, on its own ticket. The park’s adult price for the one-kilometre walk is 270,000 VND, buggy included. Vietjet still prints 250,000 VND, and the gate hours are check on arrival.

Son Doong is not a stop you add after lunch. Oxalis runs it as six days and five nights, from January to August. The park page and the operator both print 3,000 USD a person. The operator also prints 80,000,000 VND. Be in Dong Hoi by 15:00 for the briefing. The operator’s page, checked 21 Oct 2026, says the 2027 and 2028 departures are fully booked. Dark Cave and Mooc Spring are separate tickets too. The Dark Cave exploration package is 450,000 VND and includes the cave. The cheaper packages leave it out. Mooc Spring’s sightseeing price is 80,000 VND and does not include the swim. The park puts the spring about 20 minutes from Phong Nha Cave.

The other bookings are not that half-day either. The 4,500-metre kayak in Phong Nha Cave is 1,700,000 VND. The botanical garden on Road 20 is 80,000 VND, about 10 km from the Tourism Center, and the gate hours are check on arrival. OZO Park’s basic day ticket is 200,000 VND for an adult over 1.4 metres. Lunch on that ticket is extra. Hang En is two days at 9,500,000 VND, or about 358 USD, on the Oxalis page. Hang Va’s Oxalis price is 9,400,000 VND for two days, while the park’s English page prints about 346 USD. Eight Ladies Cave, at the Road 20 memorial, is free, and the hours are check on arrival. Sinh Ton Valley is 1,650,000 VND for one day or 4,700,000 VND for two, from Km 19 on the west Ho Chi Minh road. Drive minutes, and the night tour named on the boat page, stay check on arrival.
gettingAround: Dong Hoi Airport (VDH) is the air gateway. The park puts Phong Nha Cave about 50 km from Dong Hoi city. The minutes, the taxi fare, and the rail time from Hue are check on arrival. This pass did not read a Vietnam Railways timetable. At the cave, buy the ticket at the Tourism Center and walk to the pier on the left. Paradise Cave is at Km 16 on the west Ho Chi Minh road, and the minutes from the village are check on arrival.

stayAreas.name: Phong Nha village
stayAreas.summary: Sleep here if the boat leaves in the morning. The Tourism Center is the start of the half-day. Dong Hoi is the airport, about 50 km from the cave, and the minutes are check on arrival.

eat: The park does not name a market street in the village. Its culture page names Chứt and Bru–Vân Kiều dishes in the buffer villages, including cơm pồi and bánh A Chôi, without a shop address. Mooc Spring serves stream shrimp, stream fish, and chicken. Eat in the village and check the dish on arrival.
interestsBody: The boat cave is the half-day. Paradise Cave is the dry walk, on its own ticket, and the minutes from the village are check on arrival.
Chay River and Mooc Spring are the swim, on tickets that do not include the boat. The exploration package is the one that enters Dark Cave. Mooc’s 80,000 VND row is the walk, not the swim.

The expedition is Son Doong, six days with Oxalis, not a gate you walk up to. The evening is the village after the boards close. The summer boat board ends at 16:30, and the winter board ends at 15:45. The park does not say which months those are.

season.label: Check the board
season.note: The park says the Son River runs jade-green in the dry season and reddish in the rainy season, and it does not name those months. Chay River–Dark Cave may close in heavy rain, flooding, or storms. Summer and winter opening hours are both printed. Which months use which clock is check on arrival.

faqs.q: Does the Phong Nha Cave ticket include the boat?
faqs.a: No. The entrance is 150,000 VND. The boat is 700,000 VND for the round trip, for up to 12 people. Adding Tien Son on that same boat is 750,000 VND.

faqs.q: Can you visit Son Doong on your own?
faqs.a: No. Oxalis runs it as a six-day, five-night expedition from January to August. The park page and the operator both print 3,000 USD a person. The operator also prints 80,000,000 VND. Be in Dong Hoi by 15:00 for the briefing. The operator’s page, checked 21 Oct 2026, says the 2027 and 2028 departures are fully booked.

faqs.q: Is Paradise Cave the same visit as the boat?
faqs.a: No. It is a dry cave at Km 16 on the west Ho Chi Minh road. The park’s one-kilometre adult ticket is 270,000 VND and includes the buggy. The gate hours are check on arrival.
